title: Italian Fish Soup
description: A hearty Italian fish soup made with fresh fish and vegetables. Perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Fish (white firm flesh)
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fish and cook until opaque, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the fish soup and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 10-12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley and a dollop of whipped cream if desired.
